newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair says jobless figures give false picture.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair says jobless figures give false picture.

text.p: British opposition Labour Party leader Tony Blair said jobless figures showing a six year low in unemployment were not a true reflection of the situation.
"Of course, even on government figures, they are far higher than when the Conservatives came to power.

"I don't believe most people think the statistics are a true reflection of the situation, as many people are not eligible to claim unemployment benefit but are still basically unemployed," Blair told reporters on a visit to Birmingham.
"We have got a situation in this country where we have got very high levels of youth and long-term unemployment. We are too complacent about it and I think an awful lot more needs to be done."
Blair criticised the way the figures are calculated.
"They are getting lower but often by changing the way they calculate the numbers rather than by getting people into jobs," he said.
